title.en: Expanding the Frontiers of Design: Critical Perspectives
title.he: Expanding the Frontiers of Design: Critical Perspectives

abstract.en: An edited collection of selected papers from the 13th Design Thinking Research Symposium (DTRS13), exploring Design Thinking from theoretical, practical and pedagogical perspectives, with a critical analysis of the design process.

title.en: Emerging 3D technologies for future reformation of coral reefs: Enhancing biodiversity using biomimetic structures based on designs by nature
title.he: Emerging 3D technologies for future reformation of coral reefs: Enhancing biodiversity using biomimetic structures based on designs by nature

items.authors: Natalie Levy, Ofer Berman, Matan Yuval, Yossi Loya, Tali Treibitz, Ezri Tarazi, Oren Levy

abstract.en: A customizable 3D interface for producing scalable reef structures from real data collected in coral ecosystems: 3D imaging and environmental DNA feed a parametric model that is printed in naturally porous ceramic, and the same toolkit evaluates the reef after installation.
